summary: Frontend regression verification for the Cart.jsx `waNumber is not defined` fix. Tested empty /cart, /cart with a seeded item, WhatsApp CTA routing through waCartLink, mandatory phone validation + normalization, and regression across public routes. All scenarios pass with zero uncaught JS errors on the preview URL.

test_results.empty_cart_renders_no_error: PASS — 'Your basket is empty.' visible on /cart, no console/pageerror.
test_results.cart_with_item_renders_full_ui_no_Refere: PASS — cart-item, submit-inquiry-btn, wa-basket-btn all visible with 1 line item seeded via localStorage key `cart`; zero pageerrors, no `waNumber is not defined`.
test_results.whatsapp_cta_href_via_waCartLink: PASS — href starts with `https://wa.me/918920392937?text=...`, decoded prefix `Hi Samrat Glass Emporium, I would like to enquire about the following items:` present, target=_blank, item lines included.
test_results.phone_required_and_normalized: PASS — data-testid=inq-phone has HTML `required` attribute. Blank phone submit blocked by HTML5 (no POST captured). Submitting `+91 89203-92937` sends POST /api/inquiries with `customer_phone: +918920392937` (E.164 normalised).
test_results.regression_other_routes: PASS — /, /catalog, /contact, /favorites, /custom-lighting-bulk-orders, /architects-interior-designers, /product/<id> all load with no JS console errors or ReferenceErrors.

critical_code_review_comments: Note: the review_request mentions CatalogContext localStorage key `sge_cart_v1`, but the actual key in /app/frontend/src/context/CatalogContext.jsx is simply `cart`. Not a bug — just a docs mismatch that could mislead future agents seeding fixtures.

Cart.jsx line 54-56: `waLink` is computed as `waCartLink(...) || '#'`, then the JSX guard `waLink && waLink !== '#'` correctly hides the CTA when whatsapp_number is missing. Fix looks correct and minimal.
Minor: `waLink && …` in the guard is redundant since `waLink` is always a truthy string (`'#'` fallback), but not harmful.
seed_data_creation: Injected one cart line into localStorage key `cart` on the preview origin to reproduce the previously-crashing non-empty /cart render.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The regression fix (Cart.jsx guarding on waLink instead of the deleted waNumber var) is confirmed working on preview https://glass-product-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Correct localStorage seed key is `cart` (not `sge_cart_v1` as mentioned in the request). WhatsApp number configured in preview settings: +91 89203-92937 → normalised to 918920392937 in wa.me links.
rca_of_the_issue: Pre-fix: Cart.jsx JSX at line 134 referenced `waNumber` after a prior WhatsApp-standardisation refactor had removed the variable in favour of the centralised `waCartLink()` computation stored in `waLink`. Every render of /cart with a non-empty cart threw `ReferenceError: waNumber is not defined`, blanking the page. Fix guards on the existing `waLink` value (`{waLink && waLink !== '#' && (…)}`). Verified end-to-end on the preview URL — no ReferenceError, WhatsApp CTA still routes through the centralised helper with the brand-led prefix intact, and mandatory phone capture + E.164 normalisation continue to work.
